name: Western Sydney University Financial Grant
summary: Non-repayable grant for enrolled WSU students in documented hardship, covering study and essential living costs.
key: Grant applications are capped at $1,000, and laptop approvals at $750.
who: Enrolled student with documented financial hardship
Domestic: at least one subject this session; international: full load unless approved
how: Submit the online Financial Assistance application with proof of income and an invoice or quote

evidence.quote: Financial assistance will not be provided as a form of on-going income support.
